verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's documented Request Changes Workflow (reviews.request_changes_workflow in .coderabbit.yaml) makes it post a blocking 'request changes' review when it leaves actionable inline comments, and approve only once its requirements are met. The docs show a GitHub PR blocked by that review and say the decision stays synchronized with resolved feedback and Pre-Merge Checks, which directly delivers a blocking review gate. missing for 10: a documented required status-check mode, severity-specific gating that blocks only on critical findings rather than any actionable comment, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the merge gate works in practice.
